description.value:
You deploy a hovering electrocution drone that follows you and automatically zaps any enemy that ventures too close.

You deploy a Defense Drone that orbits you. The drone has 10 HP, is immune to electricity, and cannot move independently (it follows you). It persists for up to 1 minute or until destroyed.

At the start of each of your turns, the drone automatically zaps all enemies within 10 feet of you: each must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|basic|options:me-power:me-npc-tech-defense-drone] save against the creature's power DC or take @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[electricity]] damage (half on a success).

Additionally, any enemy that hits you with a melee attack while the drone is active takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d4[electricity]] damage (no save) as the drone retaliates.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
